name: Sir Schwarz
source: The president of Schwarz Bank. Although officially retired, he still oversees the company while being run by his son, Rald. While charismatic to the public, he seems to have a rather stern hand on his son. Harsh with words and explosive in temper, people generally try to avoid him on bad days, out of fear something will happen to them.
